name: When is the right time to schedule interior wear and tear repairs?

mainEntity.name: When is the right time to schedule interior wear and tear repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should book repairs before damage spreads into deeper structural layers or ahead of major life transitions like leasing, selling, or moving into a property. Small drywall cracks around doorframes can widen with seasonal settling, and chipped grout around tub surrounds or backsplashes can allow water into wall framing if left untreated. Addressing interior scuffs, settling seams, and damaged trim early prevents extensive reconstruction later and maintains property value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Schedule repairs when cosmetic blemishes begin exposing drywall or framing, before moisture enters cracked grout, or prior to listing or renting out your property.
